facts.fact: The UN Women and CBS assessment (fieldwork March-July 2021) says a new National Statistics Development Strategy (NSDS) is currently under development; the document gives no date for it, so the publication date is used.

note: Existing NSDS mentioned without period or adoption date, so no adopted fact; only the new strategy under development is a fact.

facts.fact: The abridged National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS) 2012-2016, coordinated by the CBS with UNDP support, is presented as the finalised national strategy, its design steps ending in stakeholder approval and finalisation; it does not name an adoption date, so the document date is used.
